=\displaystyle= ∑i∈I⁡(t)(𝐬1(i)−𝐬¯1+𝐬¯1)+∑k∈[t]/{𝒯⁡(k)∨{1}}(𝐬k−𝐬¯k+𝐬¯k)\displaystyle\sum_{i\in I(t)}\left(\mathbf{s}_{1}^{(i)}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}+\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}\right)+\sum_{k\in[t]/\{\mathcal{T}(k)\vee\{1\}\}}\left(\mathbf{s}_{k}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}+\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)
=\displaystyle= ∑i∈I⁡(t)(𝐬1(i)−𝐬¯1)+∑k∈[t]/{𝒯⁡(k)∨{1}}(𝐬k−𝐬¯k)+|I⁡(t)|​𝐬¯1+∑k∈[t]/{𝒯⁡(k)∨{1}}𝐬¯k\displaystyle\sum_{i\in I(t)}\left(\mathbf{s}_{1}^{(i)}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}\right)+\sum_{k\in[t]/\{\mathcal{T}(k)\vee\{1\}\}}\left(\mathbf{s}_{k}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)+|I(t)|\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}+\sum_{k\in[t]/\{\mathcal{T}(k)\vee\{1\}\}}\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}
=\displaystyle= ∑i∈I⁡(t)(𝐬1(i)−𝐬¯1)+∑k∈[t]/{𝒯⁡(k)∨{1}}(𝐬k−𝐬¯k)+∑k=1t𝐬¯k+∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)(𝐬¯1−𝐬¯k)\displaystyle\sum_{i\in I(t)}\left(\mathbf{s}_{1}^{(i)}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}\right)+\sum_{k\in[t]/\{\mathcal{T}(k)\vee\{1\}\}}\left(\mathbf{s}_{k}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)+\sum_{k=1}^{t}\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}+\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left(\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)

Where at the final step we used |I⁡(t)|=|𝒯⁡(t)|+1|I(t)|=|\mathcal{T}(t)|+1. Also note that ∑k=1t𝐬¯k=αt∇f(𝐱t)\sum_{k=1}^{t}\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}=\alpha_{t}\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right). Thus, the weighted momentum error ϵt:=𝐪t−αt∇f(𝐱t)\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}:=\mathbf{q}_{t}-\alpha_{t}\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right) is:

ϵt:=𝐪t−αt∇f(𝐱t)=∑i∈I⁡(t)(𝐬1(i)−𝐬¯1)+∑k∈[t]/{𝒯⁡(k)∨{1}}(𝐬k−𝐬¯k)+∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)(𝐬¯1−𝐬¯k)\displaystyle\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}:=\mathbf{q}_{t}-\alpha_{t}\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)=\sum_{i\in I(t)}\left(\mathbf{s}_{1}^{(i)}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}\right)+\sum_{k\in[t]/\{\mathcal{T}(k)\vee\{1\}\}}\left(\mathbf{s}_{k}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)+\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left(\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)

Due to the Martingale-like quality of ϵt\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}, we know that:

𝔼​‖ϵt‖2=∑i∈I⁡(t)𝔼​‖𝐬1(i)−𝐬¯1‖2+∑k∈[t]/{𝒯⁡(k)∨{1}}𝔼​‖𝐬k−𝐬¯k‖2+𝔼​‖∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)(𝐬¯1−𝐬¯k)‖2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}\right\|^{2}=\sum_{i\in I(t)}\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{1}^{(i)}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}\right\|^{2}+\sum_{k\in[t]/\{\mathcal{T}(k)\vee\{1\}\}}\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{k}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right\|^{2}+\mathbb{E}\left\|\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left(\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2} (14)
Lemma B.5.

Let 𝐬t=αt​𝐠t−αt−1​𝐠~t−1\mathbf{s}_{t}=\alpha_{t}\mathbf{g}_{t}-\alpha_{t-1}\tilde{\mathbf{g}}_{t-1} and 𝐬¯t=αt∇f(𝐱t)−αt−1∇f(𝐱t−1)\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{t}=\alpha_{t}\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)-\alpha_{t-1}\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right), with the assumption in Section 5.1 and αt=t\alpha_{t}=t, then:

𝔼​‖𝐬t−𝐬¯t‖2≤(σ+2​D​σL)2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{t}\right\|^{2}\leq\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)^{2}
Proof of Lemma B.5.

We will rewrite the momentum increments as 𝐬t=(αt−αt−1)​𝐠t+αt−1​(𝐠t−𝐠~t−1)\mathbf{s}_{t}=(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\mathbf{g}_{t}+\alpha_{t-1}\left(\mathbf{g}_{t}-\tilde{\mathbf{g}}_{t-1}\right) and 𝐬¯t=(αt−αt−1)∇f(𝐱t)+αt−1(∇f(𝐱t)−∇f(𝐱t−1))\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{t}=(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)+\alpha_{t-1}\left(\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right)\right)

𝔼​‖𝐬t−𝐬¯t‖2\displaystyle\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{t}\right\|^{2}}
=\displaystyle= 𝔼​‖(αt−αt−1)​(𝐠t−∇f​(𝐱t))+αt−1​((𝐠t−∇f​(𝐱t))−(𝐠~t−1−∇f​(𝐱t−1)))‖2\displaystyle\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\left(\mathbf{g}_{t}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right)+\alpha_{t-1}\left(\left(\mathbf{g}_{t}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right)-\left(\tilde{\mathbf{g}}_{t-1}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right)\right)\right)\right\|^{2}}
≤\displaystyle\leq (αt−αt−1)​𝔼​‖𝐠t−∇f​(𝐱t)‖2+αt−1​𝔼​‖(𝐠t−∇f​(𝐱t))−(𝐠~t−1−∇f​(𝐱t−1))‖2\displaystyle(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{g}_{t}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right\|^{2}}+\alpha_{t-1}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\left(\mathbf{g}_{t}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right)-\left(\tilde{\mathbf{g}}_{t-1}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right)\right)\right\|^{2}}
≤\displaystyle\leq (αt−αt−1)σ+αt−1σL𝔼​‖𝐱t−𝐱t−1‖2≤(αt−αt−1)σ+αt−1​αtα1:tDσL\displaystyle(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\sigma+\alpha_{t-1}\sigma_{L}\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{x}_{t}-\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right\|^{2}}\leq(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\sigma+\frac{\alpha_{t-1}\alpha_{t}}{\alpha_{1:t}}D\sigma_{L}

Where the first inequality is Jensen’s inequality 𝔼​‖𝐚+𝐛‖2≤𝔼​‖𝐚‖2+𝔼​‖𝐛‖2\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{a}+\mathbf{b}\right\|^{2}}\leq\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{a}\right\|^{2}}+\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{b}\right\|^{2}}, the second inequality is the bounded variance and smoothness variance, and the third inequality is the distance between adjacent queries. Since we chose αt=t\alpha_{t}=t, we get that αt−αt−1=1\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1}=1 and αt−1​αtα1:t=2​(t−1)​tt⁡(t+1)=2t−1t+1≤2\frac{\alpha_{t-1}\alpha_{t}}{\alpha_{1:t}}=\frac{2(t-1)t}{t(t+1)}=2\frac{t-1}{t+1}\leq 2. In total, we get that:

𝔼​‖𝐬t−𝐬¯t‖2≤(σ+2​D​σL)2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathbf{s}_{t}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{t}\right\|^{2}\leq\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)^{2}

∎

We now have all we need to bound ϵt\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}:

Lemma B.6.

Let 𝐝t\mathbf{d}_{t} be as in Algorithm 2, and ϵt:=αt​(𝐝t−∇f​(𝐱t))\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}:=\alpha_{t}(\mathbf{d}_{t}-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)), with the assumption in Section 5.1 and αt=t\alpha_{t}=t, with MM workers, then:

𝔼​‖ϵt‖2≤(σ+2​D​σL)2​t+(3​D​L​(M−1))2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}\right\|^{2}\leq\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)^{2}t+\left(3DL(M-1)\right)^{2}
Proof of Lemma B.6.

Continuing from Equation 14, the first two sums include a total of tt terms, each bounded by (σ+2​D​σL)2\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)^{2}. For the last term, we can bound it like this:

‖∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)(𝐬¯1−𝐬¯k)‖≤∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)‖𝐬¯1−𝐬¯k‖\displaystyle\left\|\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left(\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right)\right\|\leq\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left\|\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{1}-\bar{\mathbf{s}}_{k}\right\|
=\displaystyle= ∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)‖α1∇f(𝐱1)−(αt−αt−1)∇f(𝐱k)+αt−1(∇f(𝐱t−1)−∇f(𝐱t))‖\displaystyle\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left\|\alpha_{1}\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{1}\right)-(\alpha_{t}-\alpha_{t-1})\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{k}\right)+\alpha_{t-1}\left(\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right)-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right)\right\|
≤\displaystyle\leq ∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)‖∇f​(𝐱1)−∇f​(𝐱k)‖+∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)αt−1​‖∇f​(𝐱t−1)−∇f​(𝐱t)‖\displaystyle\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left\|\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{1}\right)-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{k}\right)\right\|+\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\alpha_{t-1}\left\|\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}\right)-\nabla f\!\left(\mathbf{x}_{t}\right)\right\|
≤\displaystyle\leq L​∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)‖𝐱1−𝐱k‖+L​∑k∈𝒯⁡(t)αt−1​‖𝐱t−1−𝐱t‖≤3​D​L​(M−1)\displaystyle L\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\left\|\mathbf{x}_{1}-\mathbf{x}_{k}\right\|+L\sum_{k\in\mathcal{T}(t)}\alpha_{t-1}\left\|\mathbf{x}_{t-1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|\leq 3DL(M-1)

Where we bound the norm with Jensen in the first two inequalities, then use the smoothness, and finally use the bounded diameter assumption and the distance between adjacent queries to bound ‖𝐱1−𝐱k‖≤D\left\|\mathbf{x}_{1}-\mathbf{x}_{k}\right\|\leq D and αt−1​‖𝐱t−1−𝐱t‖≤2​D\alpha_{t-1}\left\|\mathbf{x}_{t-1}-\mathbf{x}_{t}\right\|\leq 2D, and note that |𝒯⁡(t)|≤(M−1)|\mathcal{T}(t)|\leq(M-1). In total, we got that:

𝔼​‖ϵt‖2≤(σ+2​D​σL)2​t+(3​D​L​(M−1))2\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left\|\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}\right\|^{2}\leq\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)^{2}t+\left(3DL(M-1)\right)^{2}

∎

Proof of Theorem 5.1.

Continuing from Lemma B.4, and using Lemma B.6 to say that 𝔼​‖ϵt‖2≤(σ+2​D​σL)​t+3​D​L​(M−1)\sqrt{\mathbb{E}\left\|\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}\right\|^{2}}\leq\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)\sqrt{t}+3DL(M-1), we get this bound:

ΔT≤\displaystyle\Delta_{T}\leq 2​D2η​T2+4​D​G∗T+4​DT2​∑t=1T(σ+2​D​σL)​t+4​DT2​∑t=1T3​D​L​(M−1)\displaystyle\frac{2D^{2}}{\eta T^{2}}+\frac{4DG^{*}}{T}+\frac{4D}{T^{2}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)\sqrt{t}+\frac{4D}{T^{2}}\sum_{t=1}^{T}3DL(M-1)
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​D2η​T2+4​D​G∗T+4​D​(σ+2​D​σL)T+12​D2​L​(M−1)T\displaystyle\frac{2D^{2}}{\eta T^{2}}+\frac{4DG^{*}}{T}+\frac{4D\left(\sigma+2D\sigma_{L}\right)}{\sqrt{T}}+\frac{12D^{2}L(M-1)}{T}

Note that our only constraint on the learning rate was η≤14​L​T\eta\leq\frac{1}{4LT}, and as long as we satisfy 1T​η≤𝒪⁡((σD+σL)​T+L​M)\frac{1}{T\eta}\leq\mathcal{O}\left(\left(\frac{\sigma}{D}+\sigma_{L}\right)\sqrt{T}+LM\right), we achieve an excess loss bound of 𝒪⁡(D​σ+D2​σLT+D2​L​MT)\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{D\sigma+D^{2}\sigma_{L}}{\sqrt{T}}+\frac{D^{2}LM}{T}\right). ∎
